display.text:
[project]
name = "coucou"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Send a small moment to an always-on screen in someone's home."
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.13,<3.14"
dependencies = [
    "django>=5.2,<5.3",
    "uvicorn[standard]>=0.30",
    "cryptography>=44",
    "pillow>=11",
    "pillow-heif>=0.21",
    "pyyaml>=6",
    "django-stubs-ext>=5.1",
    "whitenoise>=6.8",
]

[project.scripts]
coucou-public = "coucou.serve:public"
coucou-admin = "coucou.serve:admin"
coucou-staging = "coucou.serve:staging"
runner = "runner.cli:main"

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "pytest>=8",
    "pytest-django>=4.9",
    "pytest-asyncio>=0.24",
    "hypothesis>=6.100",
    "ruff>=0.8",
    "mypy>=1.13",
    "django-stubs[compatible-mypy]>=5.1",
    "types-pyyaml>=6",
    "pytest-playwright>=0.5",
]
factory = [
    "fastapi>=0.142.2",
    "httpx>=0.28.1",
    "jinja2>=3.1.6",
]

[tool.uv]
# The factory group (ADR 13: the dashboard) is part of every `uv sync` and `uv run`.
default-groups = ["dev", "factory"]

[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
packages = ["coucou", "runner", "factory_dashboard"]

# --- ruff ---------------------------------------------------------------
[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
target-version = "py313"
extend-exclude = ["**/migrations/**", "*.md"]  # Markdown never gates code (ADR 01, item 2)

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "W", "I", "B", "UP", "SIM", "RUF", "S", "DTZ", "PT", "TID"]
ignore = [
    "RUF001", "RUF002", "RUF003",  # emoji and typographic characters are intentional
    "RUF012",  # Django's class attributes (list_display, Meta.constraints…) are lists by idiom
    "PT018",   # compound asserts are fine in tests
    "S603",    # subprocess with argument lists is used deliberately (runner, serve, tests)
]

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
"tests/**" = ["S101", "S104", "S105", "S106", "S310", "S311", "S607", "DTZ001"]
"runner/**" = ["S607"]  # the runner calls git, uv, opencode and claude from PATH

# --- mypy ---------------------------------------------------------------
[tool.mypy]
python_version = "3.13"
strict = true
plugins = ["mypy_django_plugin.main"]
disallow_untyped_defs = true
warn_unused_ignores = true
warn_redundant_casts = true
no_implicit_optional = true
exclude = ["/migrations/"]

[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
module = ["tests.*"]
disallow_untyped_defs = false
disallow_incomplete_defs = false
disallow_untyped_calls = false

[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
module = ["pillow_heif.*"]
ignore_missing_imports = true

[tool.django-stubs]
django_settings_module = "coucou.settings.test"

# --- pytest -------------------------------------------------------------
[tool.pytest.ini_options]
DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE = "coucou.settings.test"
testpaths = ["tests"]
addopts = "-m 'not e2e' --strict-markers"
markers = [
    "e2e: end-to-end tests against the staging environment (run with -m e2e)",
]
asyncio_mode = "auto"
asyncio_default_fixture_loop_scope = "function"
